description: DEP-01, DEP-02, and DEP-03. One preset function returns local, gpu-server, and cloud. local is the developer workstation: loopback and SQLite, and this layer declares no GPU library. The working model, observer, summarizer, and judge are OpenAI-compatible URLs from config. gpu-server is the operator's own GPU host, reached the same way as cloud. It is not the developer workstation and not a rented cloud GPU.
